scripts.migrate: pnpm run db:config && knex migrate:latest && knex seed:run
scripts.lint: echo 'No hay tareas de lint por ahora'
scripts.test: pnpm run test:sqlite && pnpm run test:postgres
scripts.test:sqlite: if [ -f test.sqlite ]; then rm test.sqlite; fi && knex migrate:latest --env testSqlite && knex seed:run --env testSqlite && knex migrate:rollback --all --env=testSqlite && if [ -f test.sqlite ]; then rm test.sqlite; fi && pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:postgres: node utils/dropTestSchema.js && knex migrate:latest --env testPostgres && knex seed:run --env testPostgres && knex migrate:rollback --all --env=testPostgres
scripts.version:patch: pnpm version patch -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.version:minor: pnpm version minor -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.version:major: pnpm version major -m "Upgrade to %s" && git push --follow-tags
